title: Ordinal
description: A venture fund site as a numbered index, paper-on-ink: a dark monospace register where the home page files the fund's focus areas as 001–006 sector vignettes (numerals computed from order, never typed), renders its underwriting formula at display scale, runs a metrics band mixing stated figures with computed counts, and numbers its principles down a timeline rail; the portfolio is a filterable spec sheet whose counts, sector chips, and status pills (“New”, “Acquired”, “Public”) compute themselves from the investment data, the team is a compact list of technical briefs, the log renders dated research notes newest-first (computed), and the disclosures get properly typeset — a multi-page site edited in one content file, with zero image assets.

theme.$comment: The achromatic overlay (the dj pack's move): mode dark opens the site as pure paper-on-ink — true-black ground (the pack's blackout pin, FundIndexPage.styles.css.ts), graph-paper hairlines (the appearance toggle still swaps to the ink-on-paper spec-sheet reading) — and the register's own inks ride as the project brand so app-side surfaces stay monochrome instead of the kernel default blue. Values match mono-utility's text inks — the landing style overrides pin accent to text, so the overlay and the pages agree.

contentContract.$comment: The pack's content slots, as data (packs/README.md 'Content contract'). Declares what a composer (agent or tool) must bind for a generated variant of this pack to present as real: slot paths into the typed content module, their kinds, and minimums. The demo fund is a Boston complex-sectors firm, but the slots are register-agnostic — any technical fund binds the same shape. Focus areas and principles are ordered arrays whose 001/002/003 numerals compute from position; statuses and dates are content, and the counts, badges, and newest-first orderings computed from them (portfolio.ts) follow wherever the data goes. Stated metrics (AUM, fund number) are strings the fund words however it likes — counted metrics never appear here because they are never hand-written.

landing.$comment: Doc-aware pack pages: routes maps each pack route to the page id its config merges under (web/app/src/View/FundIndex/FundIndexPage.tsx, useSitePageConfig). pages seeds each page's layout skeleton — ids match fundIndexLanding.ts; the platform's structural editor edits these. The preset is mono-utility in its dark reading WORN ACHROMATIC (the dj pack's move) — the style overrides pin accent to the register's own text ink, so the spec-sheet surface is pure paper-on-ink in dark and ink-on-paper in light: the index school of fund sites, precise, numbered, and colorless.
